UI_SimpleShop_CategoryFilter: Filter by item type (follows the selected mod)
UI_SimpleShop_NotListedHint: This item is not listed yet
UI_SimpleShop_SelectItem: Select an item from the list first
UI_SimpleShop_NoPermission: You do not have permission to change prices
UI_SimpleShop_SortTooltip: Choose how items are sorted (shop order is managed in the pricing window)
UI_SimpleShop_MoveTopHint: Move the selected item to the very front (listed items only)
UI_SimpleShop_MoveUpHint: Move the selected item one place forward (listed items only)
UI_SimpleShop_MoveDownHint: Move the selected item one place backward (listed items only)
UI_SimpleShop_MoveBottomHint: Move the selected item to the very end (listed items only)
UI_SimpleShop_OrderListedOnly: Only listed items can be reordered
UI_SimpleShop_OptHint: All toggles below only affect you. The "Manage Items" button additionally requires the sandbox option "SimpleShop -> Allow item configuration" in the current world before it appears in the shop window. The price table scope (whole game / this save only) is set in the sandbox option "SimpleShop -> Price table scope".
UI_SimpleShop_OptShowManageButton_tt: Show the Manage Items button at the bottom of the shop window; applies immediately after saving (off by default). Requires the sandbox option "Allow item configuration", otherwise the button stays hidden.
UI_SimpleShop_OptShowHud_tt: Show a small panel with a shopping cart icon and your balance on the right side of the screen; click it to open the shop, drag it to move (on by default)
UI_SimpleShop_OptShowContextMenu: Show "Open Shop" in the right-click menu
UI_SimpleShop_OptShowContextMenu_tt: Show the Open Shop entry when right-clicking the world or inventory; when off, use the floating balance panel or the key bind (off by default)
UI_SimpleShop_OptOpenKey_tt: Press this key to open the shop window directly (unbound by default; click the button and press the key you want)
UI_SimpleShop_OptManageKey_tt: Press this key to open the item pricing window, press it again to close it (unbound by default; requires the sandbox option "Allow item configuration")
